name: Non-local Approximated Gradients
definition: A gradient computation method that uses gradients of pixels backpropagated from a loss function to overcome poor local minima and lack of objective awareness in standard differentiable rendering.
summary: Non-local approximated gradients are a differentiable rendering technique that uses loss function gradients to provide objective-aware, non-zero gradients for geometric optimization, unlike standard methods relying on local geometric derivatives.
